feedback.end: Trees live for hundreds of years. The oldest tree on earth is over 5,000 years old! Most trees are cut down for their wood before they reach that age.
We can measure how old a tree is by counting its rings. Each ring represents one year. Depending on the weather, the rings can be thicker or thinner.

instruction.text: Trees have lots of different jobs to do. Select the correct jobs.

sound: Trees create habitats for animals and other plants.

finish.text: Trees are super important! One tree can produce enough oxygen for five people each day.
